title: Server sends a service, auth or connection message while inside a key exchange
quote: Once a party has sent a SSH_MSG_KEXINIT message for key exchange or re-exchange, until it has sent a SSH_MSG_NEWKEYS message (Section 7.3), it MUST NOT send any messages other than: o Transport layer generic messages (1 to 19) (but SSH_MSG_SERVICE_REQUEST and SSH_MSG_SERVICE_ACCEPT MUST NOT be sent); o Algorithm negotiation messages (20 to 29) (but further SSH_MSG_KEXINIT messages MUST NOT be sent); o Specific key exchange method messages (30 to 49).
rationale: The server has sent KEXINIT before the first step (absorbed by reset()). Until an output contains NEWKEYS, and again from a later server KEXINIT until its NEWKEYS, an output with SERVICE_ACCEPT or any UA_*/GLOBAL_REQUEST/REQUEST_*/CH_* message is a violation, e.g. SR_AUTH -> SERVICE_ACCEPT before key exchange. The step that carries the server KEXINIT itself is not checked, since token order within one output is not visible to the pattern.
